subject.title: feat(control-ui): rename sessions from the sidebar via the server label patch (#90655)

question: Should this stale narrow sidebar-rename branch be rebased and repaired, or should maintainers adopt a broader session-history PR as the canonical UX path?
rationale: Current main moved the sidebar into new components and there are overlapping proof-positive rename/history PRs, so automation should not choose the product surface or canonical branch by itself.
